top_rigor_problems: Term glosses are pasted onto the wrong person: 'virginitas, lifelong virginity given to God' is attached to the widow Blaesilla (n25). The same glossing step injects definitions mid-sentence in n1, n12, n17 and n21.

Contested claims slip back to settled when the contested_claim record is not retrieved: Paula's total renunciation (n23), and Marcella's standing 'without contest' (n13). When the contested record is cited (n10), the answer handles it well.

Cell-canonical witnesses are sometimes missed in favour of reused ones: hal.dw.church-failure was not used for F3-P (n15), hal.dw.doubt not for F1-P (n7), and hal.dw.marriage-ending not for F5-T (n24). Recycled hal.dw.record and hal.dw.apostolic paragraphs then fill the gap off-question.
top_access_problems: Engine cuts leave orphans and non-sequiturs: 'those words' (n4), 'those answers' (n5), 'She was not reporting a vision' (n11), 'That tells you what they prized' (n21), 'It is only this:' (n7), double periods (n2, n22), and a stray Chinese character 'The争' (n6).
Block quotes are paraphrased and then quoted in full (the Fabiola penance in n7 and n15, Rufinus in n6), producing 57-72-word sentences and 300-420-word answers.
Build and record vocabulary leaks into the voice: 'We are the representative' (n27), 'real period wording, though it is not quoted' (n17), 'one uncorroborated count' (n21), and 'Our record shows'.
world_summary.cost_note: Per-answer cost is flat at about $0.02 (n1 at $0.079 is an uncached outlier). The waste is in output words: n15 (~170 words beyond need), n7 (~140), n6 (~130), n9 (~120) and n10 (~110) are long mainly because of duplicated block quotes or pasted witness paragraphs (hal.dw.record and hal.dw.apostolic recur in n1, n2, n9, n12, n18 and n24). About 1,500 surplus words across 28 answers, roughly 20%.
world_summary.go_live_view: Close but not yet. Rigor is the world's strength. The answers are honest about Jerome's single voice, the epitaph genre, the lost women's words and the material silence, and only two of 28 would draw a historian's objection (Blaesilla as a virgin; Paula's renunciation stated as total). Access is the weaker side: ten answers need a craft fix, nearly all for engine-cut orphans, a stray glyph, or duplicated block quotes, not for the voice itself. The single most valuable fix is in the engine: stop it pasting term glosses and block quotes inline, and check for orphaned pronouns or lead-ins after a sentence is cut. That one change would clear most FIX items and the n25 error. Retrieving contested_claim records whenever a cited story carries one would clear the rest.
